description: Three-level NPC inverter. Watch neutral-point balance, THD, and dead-time distortion.

pathologies.explanation: Significant amplitude or phase imbalance between the three phases. Check dq decoupling and PLL tracking.
Output current THD exceeds 5%. Check LCL filter resonance, active damping, dead-time compensation, and neutral-point balancing.
Output never approaches target — check gate drive, DC bus voltage, and modulation enable.
